callouts.title: 命题1：一维的广义的Riemann-Lebesgue引理
callouts.body:
$f \in L^{1}([a,b])$并且$g$是周期为$T$的可测有界周期函数那么$$\lim_{n
\to +\infty}\int_{[a,b]} f(x)g(nx) dx =\left(\frac{1}{T}\int_{[0,T)}g(x)\,dx\right)\left(\int_{[a,b]}f(x)\,dx\right)$$ 即周期函数在一个周期内积分的平均值乘上可积函数在闭区间上的积分。

if_problem.statement_en:
Let $f \in L^{1}([a,b])$, and let $g$ be a measurable bounded periodic function with period $T$. Then
$$\lim_{n\to +\infty}\int_{[a,b]} f(x)g(nx)\, dx =\left(\frac{1}{T}\int_{[0,T)}g(x)\,dx\right)\left(\int_{[a,b]}f(x)\,dx\right).$$
That is, the limit equals the average value of $g$ over one period multiplied by the integral of $f$ over the interval.
